# ConvNeXt

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/convnext.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/convnext.py) ·
**Architectures:** 31 · **Pretrained weights:** 101 (61 with ImageNet-1k results)

ConvNeXt is a pure convolutional network that adopts design choices from vision transformers, such as large depthwise
kernels, inverted bottlenecks and LayerNorm. ConvNeXt-V2 adds Global Response Normalization (GRN) and is pretrained as a
fully convolutional masked autoencoder (FCMAE).

## Papers

* [A ConvNet for the 2020s](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.03545)
* [ConvNeXt-V2 - Co-designing and Scaling ConvNets with Masked Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.00808)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('convnext_tiny.in12k_ft_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```
